notes: The public Alizé Liberté tariff and the 4 EUR/month preferred offer are distinct direct layers.
Connection-time components are modeled as time-based surcharges after the published thresholds, not as energy prices.
Third-party mobility operators may apply their own customer tariff and are therefore kept separate from Alizé Toulouse direct pricing.

accessMethods: contactless bank card on ultra-rapid stations

classification.reason: Allego publishes France default tariffs but explicitly states charge-point prices may vary by charger type and location/tender.

regularChargingOverstay.note: Current official AC overstay rules shown are Netherlands-specific (5h) and Brussels Tour & Taxis-specific (6h); neither is projected to France.

notes: Allego Direct country prices are defaults, not a guarantee for every Allego charge point.
HPC idle fee is charged only after active charging has ended; the first 45 minutes from session start are exempt.
Regular-charging overstay fee is modeled separately from the HPC idle fee.
Third-party MSP pricing must not be treated as Allego Direct/App pricing.

roaming.note: MSP final tariff may differ from Allego direct/app pricing.

classification.reason: The published eborn tariff applies to the eborn network only. EASYCHARGE also operates other networks, which must be qualified separately.

notes: Do not apply this tariff to AVIA VOLT by EASYCHARGE or other EASYCHARGE networks.
On fast/ultra-fast stations, the published non-subscriber tariff also applies to lower-power Type 2 charging on those stations.
Other eMSP tariffs are separate roaming prices.
The 49 EUR/month plan is modeled as a 250 kWh monthly allowance, not as a fake per-kWh tariff.
Post-charge fees start 30 minutes after charge-end detection; accelerated chargers apply them only from 08:00 to 20:00.
Third-party badges on eborn remain eMSP pricing; outgoing eborn roaming is modeled separately with the published 15% markup.
Municipal or private parking costs remain site-specific and are not folded into the network energy tariff.

payload.notes: Electra's July/August 2026 official materials state that France app pricing is dynamic by time and station demand and ranges from 0.39 to 0.61 EUR/kWh; the exact rate is shown before the session and is then locked. The official station site also states that the user pays the price shown in the app or on the charger before plugging in.
payload.rule: Never apply the 0.39-0.61 EUR/kWh range, a nearby station price, or any headline Electra price as a station fallback. For a TCC station/EVSE, use only the current exact tariff shown for that exact station in the official Electra app or on the charger before plugging in, preserving any time-dependent price band. If that exact station price is not captured or cannot be mapped deterministically, leave the station/EVSE fail-closed and unpriced.

classification.reason: E55C's current charging tutorial states that the applicable ad-hoc bank-card price is displayed before payment; no single nationwide consumer amount is published there.

fees.note: Any additional direct-session, occupancy or site parking rule must be resolved from the pre-payment station flow or another explicit site source.

indicativeWholesaleTariffsToMobilityOper.note: E55C explicitly says these TTC amounts are billed to mobility operators and do not determine the final user price.

inventory.note: Official E55C data.gouv resources are used only as network/inventory evidence in this operator-rule validator.

notes: This validator intentionally does not build a national station database.
Do not use E55C's indicative operator wholesale minute rates as the final Charge Companion consumer tariff.
For direct ad-hoc bank-card charging, resolve the exact station/session price from E55C's pre-payment flow.
The contradictory legacy FAQ is preserved as monitored evidence rather than silently overriding the current ad-hoc flow.

sourceConflict.currentTutorialStatement: Current tutorial offers pay-as-you-go bank-card charging without registration, app or badge and shows the tariff before payment.
sourceConflict.legacyFaqStatement: FAQ says E55C does not offer direct billing and direct bank-card payment is not authorised on the network.
sourceConflict.resolution: Use the current operational tutorial for present ad-hoc access; retain the FAQ contradiction as a monitored stale-content signal.

parkingAndOccupancy.note: Model the published connection-time component separately from municipal parking. The official FAQ also states non-connected vehicles may be ticketed.

subscription.note: An older official Freshmile page describes an 8 EUR/month Elsass subscription, but the current exact member tariff and current purchaseability are not proven by the tariff page. Keep the member offer out of ranking until reconfirmed.

tccDecision.note: Use the current Elsass public tariff and ENGIE Vianeo app -10% energy tariff as separate rankable variants. Keep member and roaming prices separate until current exact pricing is proven.

classification.reason: Current sources show several e-Totem-managed networks and distinct local tariff schedules; one universal CPO-direct France tariff must not be assumed.

notes: This validator intentionally does not build a national station database.
Do not reuse the historical 2024 0.39/0.49 CPO or 0.49/0.59 partner-network announcements as universal current tariffs without current first-party confirmation.
SEMOB is a regional offer and must not be shown as a nationwide e-Totem subscription.
Saint-Louis Agglomeration demonstrates that e-Totem-managed direct tariffs and post-charge fees can be local-network specific.
Exact normalized station-id match only; unmatched stations fail closed.
Official sWebTexte is preserved without tariff inference.

classification.reason: Load Stations/Load Motion exposes a public application and a guest charging-station check route, but the exact guest station flow requires a valid reCAPTCHA token and secured pricing-definitions/station APIs require authentication. Extensive bundle/config/API probing identified the pricing contract but not an anonymous tariff feed. The current native Load Stations app supports QR start, payment and tariff display, but no anonymous public mobile tariff endpoint has been found. ChargePoint public exact-EVSE oracle found no Load Stations-attributed exact tariff rows.

payload.unblockRequirement: Authenticated/legitimate app capture, a valid user-driven guest flow, or another public source that returns the exact direct tariff for a Load Stations EVSE without extrapolation.

payload.rule: Apply this grid only to EVSE positively identified as direct STATIONS-E network points and whose documented connector/power class is 22AC, 24DC, or 50DC. Never apply these values to partner/roaming stations, Load Stations rows merely sharing a candidate source file, an unknown power class, or a station whose direct-network identity is not established. Preserve offer-specific prices and post-charge parking conditions. Any unresolved EVSE remains fail-closed/unpriced.

notes: The per-minute components are triggered by total connection duration after the published threshold, not specifically by the end of energy delivery.
The SYDED page states that the displayed tariffs are accessible via Electromaps. Users of another operator/eMSP must check that provider's own retail price.

The SYDED operator page is the machine-validated source of truth for the complete 22/50/100 kW tariff grid; the regional BFC page is intentionally not required because its rendered content is unstable in GitHub Actions.
Third-party roaming prices must therefore remain separate from the SYDED/Electromaps published tariff grid.

payload.sourceNuance: Current SYDER page publishes the tariff as an official image. Numeric values were rechecked against that live image on 2026-08-21; the runner validates page and image availability rather than OCR text.

sourceEvidence.transportNote: Official SYDEV host currently presents an incomplete certificate chain to some Linux runners; payload is still constrained to the official hostname and validated by expected content plus SHA-256.

notes: The published 22 kW night rule waives only the time component from 19:00 to 09:00; the 0.60 EUR/kWh energy component remains payable.
The 0.02/0.03/0.05 EUR per-minute components are connection-time charges after 180/90/60 minutes respectively, not post-charge-only idle fees.
Contactless bank-card payment is modeled only for stations equipped with a payment terminal; it is not asserted as universal across TDE 90.
Third-party mobility-provider retail prices must remain separate from the TDE 90 / Electromaps published tariff.

tccDecision.reason: TE80 currently publishes exact energy and connection-time rules effective 2026-01-28; Freshmile operates the network and roaming mobility providers may apply separate fees.

network.scopeNote: This record covers TEA-operated/demonstration IRVE only; it does not claim that TEA operates all public chargers in Alsace.

payload.rule: Use only the exact current tariff bands displayed on the official Tesla Find Us page for the exact Supercharger site, preserving Tesla-owner versus other-EV pricing and time bands. Never infer a national Tesla tariff or copy a nearby site's rate. Any station not successfully resolved from its exact official page remains fail-closed/unpriced.

classification.reason: Station-service CPO pricing, local concession pricing, and Charge+ eMSP/member pricing are distinct tariff families.

aixMarseilleProvenceCity.scope: eligible TotalEnergies-operated roadside chargers in Métropole Aix-Marseille-Provence; excludes station-service

notes: Do not merge Charge+ roaming prices with TotalEnergies CPO-direct prices.
Station-service pricing is a published tariff family, not a guarantee for every TotalEnergies-operated concession.
The 0.50 EUR/min station-service occupation fee starts after 45 consecutive minutes connected and continues while plugged in.
City Aix-Marseille-Provence DC preferential pricing is acknowledged but not numerically machine-validated because the current official rate is embedded in an image table.
